name: A living material study
art: The original image is site/assets/atelier/living-terrarium.webp. A detailed image is essential; do not try to substitute a translucent div containing generic plant icons.

properties.label: Terrarium with editorial inspection
properties.text: Let a massive thick-glass vessel containing a miniature moss garden dominate the right. Use a calm left editorial column with three numbered inspection points, and a circular loupe that lets a small detail command as much attention as the whole silhouette.

properties.label: Layered miniature garden
properties.text: Build the image from condensation beads, layered ferns, wet stone, soft moss and a small dark pool at several scales of detail.

properties.label: Sage-gray and dark green
properties.text: Use a sage-gray ground, dark green type and natural wet greens within the vessel.

properties.label: Thick distorting terrarium glass
properties.text: Use thick clear glass that distorts the miniature scene at its edge and carries large soft reflections.

properties.label: Canopy-penetrating light
properties.text: Let light penetrate the canopy and cast contact shadows on the rocks.

properties.label: Registered magnifying loupe
properties.text: Glass & water, Canopy & light and Stone & moss move a true magnifying crop to the corresponding feature while preserving pixel alignment after resize.

properties.label: Raster magnification boundary
properties.text: This is an original high-resolution raster scene with a CSS magnification layer, not interactive simulated water.

properties.label: Loupe registration check
properties.text: Compare loupe registration, glass rim, condensation and leaf scale.

properties.label: Bounded portrait loupe
properties.text: Test all inspection points in portrait; keep the lens inside the image and away from the reading column.
